plan.content:
# Learn recursion

1. Trace a countdown to its base case.
2. Follow each return back to its caller.
3. Apply the trace to a folder tree.

verification.checklist:
- [ ] Identify the base case.
- [ ] Mark the call that returns first.

deck.title: Recursion cards
deck.description: Sample recall practice for the Recursion Workshop.

cards.front: What happens to a call while its recursive call runs?
cards.back: It waits at the call site with its own local variables.
A branch that returns without making another recursive call.

feedback.evidence: Sample feedback: I couldn't follow the return order yet.
Sample feedback: Following the countdown from zero clarified the order.
